Attio is a CRM for managing contacts, relationships, and workflows.
Twenty is an open-source CRM with APIs suitable for agent tools.
Podio is an app-based work platform with an API covering workspaces, apps, items, tasks, and other objects.

Freshdesk is a cloud helpdesk with a broad public REST API and an official MCP server; API credentials are available through a 14-day trial or a paid plan, not the free plan.

Front (front.com) is a cloud shared-inbox and helpdesk. It has a public REST Core API (OAuth2 or company API tokens) covering conversations, messages, contacts, inboxes and more, a 14-day self-serve Professional trial that includes API access, and an official hosted MCP server.
Cloud B2B helpdesk with a broad bearer-token REST API and an official MCP server, reachable only through a paid plan or a sales-arranged trial.

LiveAgent is a cloud help desk (with a self-hosted option) that has a broad REST API and an official MCP server, but working credentials exist only inside a 30-day free trial or a paid plan, and the MCP server itself is gated to Business and Enterprise.
Plain is a cloud B2B support platform with a public GraphQL API and an official remote MCP server, but API credentials are only reachable through a 7-day free trial of a paid plan.
Hosted customer-support platform with a broad public REST API usable today, but credentials only via a paid plan or a 15-day trial.
Cloud ecommerce helpdesk with a broad public REST API; the only self-serve account is a 7-day trial, and publishing an app for other merchants requires vendor review.

one_line_summary: Vonage offers self-serve credentials and public APIs for messaging, voice, numbers, applications, and account management.
Google Ads has a broad, publicly documented API and an official MCP server. Self-serve access supports test accounts; live-account access requires an application.
Meta Ads is a cloud advertising platform with a broad, documented Marketing API, a no-spend developer sandbox, and an official hosted MCP server launched in open beta.

LinkedIn's hosted Marketing/Advertising API is a broad REST API with 3-legged OAuth, but working credentials require applying for and being approved for the Advertising API product; third-party MCP servers exist and Composio lists a toolkit.

GoHighLevel has a broad, publicly documented cloud API and an official MCP server. Developers can build and test API-backed tools in a self-service sandbox; production use requires separate credentials.
Mailchimp has a broad, publicly documented Marketing API, but the evidence reviewed does not establish whether its Free plan yields working API credentials.
Klaviyo offers a broad REST API, API-key and OAuth authentication, and an official MCP server.
systeme.io is a hosted funnel and marketing platform with a public REST API and a vendor-operated MCP server.

Threads is Meta’s text-first social network for public conversations, with an API for organic publishing, reply moderation, and performance reporting.
SendGrid offers a public REST API for email sending, campaigns, contacts, and statistics, with API access available through a 60-day free trial.

Shopify has a broad, publicly documented commerce API and a free dev-store path for building and testing integrations. Its available official MCP server serves shopping agents; the announced store-management MCP server is not yet public.
